header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w ASP Abdul Basit
SDPO Satellite Town, Mirpurkhas, S.H.O P.S G. Laghari on
behalf of SSP Badin and ASI Ghulam Rasool of PS
None present for the petitioners, nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2016. Learned A.A.G has filed parawise comments of A.I.G.P Legal-II for I.G.P Sindh and has challenged the maintainability of instant petition while submitting that after recent judgment, this petition is not maintainable as petitioners have remedy to approach Service Tribunal. In view of such objection, this petition is hereby dismissed being non-maintainable alongwith listed pending applications, leaving the petitioners at liberty to approach Service Tribunal for redressal of their grievance. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
